task.description:
Run the full test suite against BACKEND-DEV's LUA-08/09/10 limiter-wiring implementation (commits 944974d, 293c84c on this branch). ORCH already ran zig build test-env-verify and confirmed HEALTHY (10/10 checks) -- but ONLY after overriding a STALE shell environment variable. IMPORTANT: this Bash session's persisted BPM_TEST_DB_URL is stuck at postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test (port 5434 -- a SIBLING workspace's port), which does NOT match this workspace's .env (port 5453, COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=r-co-2). The r-co-2-db_test-1 container is genuinely healthy and publishes port 5453 correctly -- this is a shell session artifact, NOT a real infrastructure problem. You MUST prefix every test/build command that reads BPM_TEST_DB_URL with an inline override: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test <command> -- or export it correctly at the start of your session -- do NOT trust whatever is already in the shell environment.

ORCH also independently re-verified BACKEND-DEV's work before this handoff: ran zig build (exit 0), confirmed no 'error set' output, ran zig build test-lua directly (16/16 steps succeeded, 81/81 tests passed, ~29s), and personally performed an independent mutation test on instruction_limiter.zig's installLimiter (commented out the lua_sethook call, confirmed zig build test-lua hangs past 45s as predicted, restored via git checkout, confirmed clean rebuild afterward: 81/81 tests passed again). BACKEND-DEV's own mutation-test claims (hook removal -> hang, watchdog-disable -> TC-LUA-10-02/03 failure) are corroborated, not just self-reported.

Run your full standard pre-check sequence (backend services check, Infrastructure Health Checklist, zig build test-env-verify) with the BPM_TEST_DB_URL override applied throughout, then run the full test suite (zig build test, not just test-lua) to catch any regression outside the Lua subsystem -- BACKEND-DEV's changes touched execution_test.zig and capability_enforcement_test.zig (shared test infrastructure signature changes for createSandboxedState's new RunLimits parameter) and src/simulation/service_interceptor.zig + src/simulation/types.zig (an incidental allocator-mismatch bug fix + a new MockResponse.delay_ms test seam) -- confirm nothing else that depends on either shared file broke.
